title: Carta Fund ERP — Screen and Behavior Research Specification
scope: Public official Carta documentation, product pages, release notes, developer references and written product-tour transcripts. No prior recreation project used.
status: Document-grounded functional specification; not an authenticated visual-parity audit and not a production financial-engine specification.

evidence_legend.D: Documented by a retrieved official source; not necessarily executed or visually verified.
evidence_legend.V: Directly inspected visual evidence. No full current screen in this inventory is rated V.
evidence_legend.I: Proposed implementation interpretation or synthetic acceptance requirement.

principles.title: Separate product surfaces
principles.description: Forecasting, fund-administration visual accounting, Deal CRM, LP CRM, LP Portal and allocator analytics are distinct experiences. A shared brand does not establish one identical shell or menu.

principles.title: Separate economic states
principles.description: Use different concepts for a construction plan, actual investment history, current forecast, investment case, fund scenario and posted accounting. This proposed architecture preserves documented distinctions; it is not Carta’s private schema.

principles.title: Treat save, calculate, approve and post as different actions
principles.description: Do not substitute a toast for a state transition. Some inputs require nested save, some require recalculation, some need review, and some enter accounting only when posted.

principles.title: Keep records scoped to legal entities and people
principles.description: Connected records still have legal-entity, role and disclosure boundaries. LP-specific permissions and date-cutoff policies must change data access, not just hide tabs.

principles.title: Preserve source and freshness
principles.description: A company’s collected KPI, an imported investment event, a manual forecast assumption and a warehouse-derived metric have different provenance and update schedules.

principles.title: Distinguish service workflows from software calculations
principles.description: Tax preparation, formation, compliance review and bank payment execution include human or external systems. A prototype can model statuses but must not claim those services were actually performed.

screens.title: Home and fund creation
screens.controls: Strategy templates and fund creation action.
screens.documented_behavior: Select a starting strategy, enter the construction wizard, then complete setup. A template initializes assumptions; it is not proof of an investment policy.
screens.unverified: Exact Home cards, sort/filter controls, delete/duplicate actions and empty state.

screens.title: Construction Wizard
screens.entry: New fund or existing construction configuration
screens.controls: General; Sector Profiles; Allocations; Fees/Expenses; optional Recycling; Waterfall; optional Limited Partners.
screens.documented_behavior: These seven documented sections define the model. Treat them as persistent economic inputs rather than disposable onboarding answers.
screens.unverified: Stepper appearance, save timing between sections, unsaved-change dialogs and complete validation copy.

screens.title: General fund configuration
screens.controls: Fund name, currency, start/end dates, commitment, GP commitment, call cadence, commitment schedules and vehicle structure.
screens.documented_behavior: An omitted end date supports an evergreen model. SPV/no-construction mode disables automatic construction of new investments. A traditional construction fund and an actual legally formed SPV are different concepts.
screens.unverified: All current defaults; eligibility of credit-line options; exact validation and logo-placement behavior.

screens.title: Sector-profile stage editor
screens.controls: Stage rows; round size; pre/post-money value; option-pool dilution; graduation/exit probabilities; exit values; months to next stage/exit; add/remove/reorder.
screens.documented_behavior: Failure probability is the remainder after graduation and exit. Their sum must not exceed 100%; the last stage cannot graduate. Reordering is documented. Stage timing is relative to entering that stage. Applying market data can replace profile assumptions.
screens.unverified: Exact rounding, validation messages, full market-data filter and overwrite confirmation UI.

screens.title: Allocation editor
screens.entry: Current Allocations → New Allocation, or open an existing allocation
screens.controls: Profile, entry stage, share of investable capital, initial amount/ownership target, follow-on amount/ownership target, participation and deployment horizon.
screens.documented_behavior: The model deploys the allocation budget. Larger follow-on reserves can reduce the projected number of initial deals. Initial deployment pacing follows the investment horizon; follow-on timing follows stage graduation timing.
screens.unverified: Granular timing controls beyond the documented horizon, dirty-state behavior and all allocation-sum constraints.

screens.title: Fee and expense schedules
screens.controls: Fee profiles with dated tiers, percentage and fee basis; additional tiers; expenses with monthly amount and dates.
screens.documented_behavior: Different LPs can use different fee profiles. Bases include commitments, several called-capital measures, invested capital, fair value and unrealized cost. Recycling settings exist at fee-tier level.
screens.unverified: Every tier-overlap rule, day-count convention, fee-on-fee behavior and rounding.

screens.title: Exit-recycling configuration
screens.controls: Recyclable percentage, cap relative to commitments, recycling term, optional use of anticipated proceeds.
screens.documented_behavior: The anticipation option allows earlier deployment based on future exits; otherwise recycling waits for exits. Fee recycling and exit recycling have different caps. Neither represents fresh LP commitments.
screens.unverified: Interaction of simultaneous caps, shortfall handling and detailed ledger presentation.

screens.title: Fund-level waterfall assumptions
screens.controls: European/American structure, preferred return/hurdle, catch-up and carried-interest settings.
screens.documented_behavior: The documentation distinguishes whole-fund and deal-level distribution approaches. Returns on the GP commitment are separate from GP carry.
screens.unverified: Complete legal waterfall semantics, clawback interpretation and uncommon tier structures. Do not confuse this with multi-entity ERP waterfall modeling.

screens.title: Modeled limited partners
screens.controls: Add/import LPs, contributions/schedules, fee-profile assignment, optional custom profit splits.
screens.documented_behavior: Without detailed LPs, returns can be modeled for an aggregate LP bucket. Custom splits can vary by distribution tier; this is a modeling input, not the LP-facing investor portal.
screens.unverified: Links to actual legal investor records, contribution-schedule error rules and current entitlement.

screens.title: Construction/Current analytical dashboard
screens.controls: Construction Forecast and Current Forecast selection; computed analytics.
screens.documented_behavior: Construction excludes actual investments. Current incorporates actual investments and projects remaining deployment. Changes to construction assumptions after deployment concern remaining capital, not rewriting historical transactions.
screens.unverified: Current full tab order, chart layouts, hover behavior, axes, legends, zooming, default periods and exact navigation shell.

screens.title: Monthly cash-flow actuals editor
screens.entry: Model View → Period → Current Forecast + Monthly → Edit Actuals
screens.controls: Editable cells for commitments, calls, fees, expenses, recycling and distributions; Save Edits.
screens.documented_behavior: The guide identifies editable actuals in blue. Saving changes actual cash-flow reporting, but does not itself replan future investments or change projected deal count/investable capital.
screens.unverified: Cell-level validation, locked periods, paste handling, undo and conflict resolution.

screens.title: Actual-investments table
screens.controls: Company and investment fields, status, ownership, invested/reserved capital, current/exit returns and reporting attributes.
screens.documented_behavior: This is a consolidated view of actual portfolio records. Planned is a forecasting investment status; it is not automatically a Deal CRM pipeline stage.
screens.unverified: Precise default columns, sorting, filtering, pagination and row-action menus in the current account.

screens.title: Saved table views and report configuration
screens.entry: Investments → Columns; Portfolio Summary report → Customize
screens.controls: Select fields; save a default/new/replacement view; load an investment view into report configuration.
screens.documented_behavior: A saved column selection can be reused for an Excel portfolio report. Field catalogs vary by surface/version; do not fix the product to a marketing count of metrics.
screens.unverified: Per-user versus shared ownership of saved views, exact report format and export formatting.

screens.title: Investment creation and editor
screens.entry: Investments → Add Investment → profile → entry stage
screens.controls: Name and descriptive fields; first investment event; exit event; bulk Excel import.
screens.documented_behavior: A future first investment is Planned. The guide requires at least one investment round and one exit event, which may be projected. First investment date cannot precede fund inception. Imported rounds need future/exit assumptions reviewed.
screens.unverified: Complete forms, import-template columns, merge/deduplication, delete behavior and status-transition rules.

screens.title: Round/event editor
screens.controls: Financing, ownership update, valuation update, secondary purchase, partial sale, investment income; reserve/pro-rata and priced-share inputs.
screens.documented_behavior: Closing the nested event editor is followed by Save Changes on the investment. Future rounds can be generated from a profile. Priced-share entry is not the SAFE/note input flow.
screens.unverified: Exact dirty-state/cancel behavior and calculation order for same-date events.

screens.title: Investment performance cases
screens.entry: Investment editor → Add Case / case Actions
screens.controls: Case probabilities, event sequences, clone, historical synchronization, future-round generation and case results.
screens.documented_behavior: Case probability and within-case graduation probability are distinct. Cloning a case copies its rounds; historical synchronization copies historical events only. The guide allows up to ten cases per investment.
screens.unverified: Probability normalization, treatment of missing probabilities and deletion confirmations.

screens.title: Fund-wide Scenario Builder
screens.controls: Scenario name, modified assumptions across construction/investments, recalculation, save and comparison results.
screens.documented_behavior: A scenario combines changes at fund level; choosing an investment case is only one input. Recalculate and Save Scenario are documented actions.
screens.unverified: Exact unsaved-state appearance, baseline comparison columns and whether/how a scenario can be applied to the base model.

screens.title: Time Machine historical view
screens.entry: Investments → Time Machine in the top-right header
screens.controls: Historical month, active-state button, Reset to today.
screens.documented_behavior: Investment metrics recalculate for the selected month. The guide describes a red active-state control. Reset restores the present-day view. This is not restoration of an old saved version.
screens.unverified: Effect on every other module, date boundary conventions and whether the selection survives navigation/reload.

screens.title: KPI definitions and values
screens.entry: Sidebar → KPI Manager → company → Add KPI
screens.controls: Predefined/custom metrics, quantitative/qualitative types, cadence, periods and data grid.
screens.documented_behavior: Metrics are saved against a company; linked source collection and user-entered values must retain their distinct provenance.
screens.unverified: Every allowed metric type, precise missing-data convention and definition-edit behavior.

screens.title: KPI requests and review
screens.controls: Contacts, request period, selected metrics, access protection, send/copy link, review and approval settings.
screens.documented_behavior: Request states include Pending Update and Pending Review. Recipients submit without creating an account. Managers compare old/new values and accept or reject. Auto-Approve can bypass manual review.
screens.unverified: Email delivery errors, reminder defaults, link expiry and exact permission matrix.

screens.title: Custom formula builder
screens.controls: Named variables from KPIs or reporting fields; relative periods; equation and output type; Calculate; Save/Load Formula.
screens.documented_behavior: Formula results can be inspected and downloaded. Relative KPI periods shift when recalculated, rather than remaining fixed to the original calendar dates.
screens.unverified: Expression grammar, null/error propagation, cross-company aggregation and security implementation.

screens.title: Follow-on reserve analysis
screens.controls: Company comparison of expected return on the next reserve dollar, planned reserves and deployed capital.
screens.documented_behavior: The ranking measures incremental follow-on economics, not simply the return already achieved on the original investment. It is an analytical view, not an instruction to automatically transact.
screens.unverified: Exact chart encoding, full return calculation, optimization constraints and interactive selection behavior.

screens.title: Document Center
screens.controls: Document name, optional investment/category association and bulk upload.
screens.documented_behavior: Files can be organized within forecasting and linked to investment context. These are not automatically the full audit/tax-document repository.
screens.unverified: Previewer, version replacement, deletion, malware scanning and folder behavior.

screens.title: Publishing controls and reader
screens.controls: Read-only link, optional access protection, GP-data visibility, LP-specific disclosure options.
screens.documented_behavior: Publishing is different from inviting an editor. The published experience is read-only; LP-scoped disclosure can exclude other LP returns.
screens.unverified: Live-link versus snapshot refresh semantics, revocation, expiry, exact reader layout and export permissions.

screens.title: Collaborator administration
screens.entry: Home → Manage Collaborator, or sidebar → Collaborators
screens.controls: Email invitation and section-level read/write permissions.
screens.documented_behavior: The guide describes an account requirement and a default full-write invitation. Do not assume a read-only default merely because that would be safer design.
screens.unverified: Every permission row, invitation expiry and current plan requirements.

screens.title: Multi-fund analytical view
screens.entry: Home → Multi-Fund View → Create a Multi-Fund View
screens.controls: Name, vehicle selection and Save.
screens.documented_behavior: Selected vehicles are pooled for analytics; the guide requires the same fund currency. This is not an ownership transaction or a fund-of-funds investment.
screens.unverified: Exact consolidated metric logic, eliminations, supported count and current packaging.

screens.title: Round-currency and FX controls
screens.controls: Round currency and exchange rate; manual entry or lookup; valuation update.
screens.documented_behavior: Round inputs retain their currency while fund reporting uses fund currency. The guide describes later valuation updates for FX revaluation; closing the round still requires investment-level save.
screens.unverified: Rate source/date conventions, precision and FX attribution in every metric.

screens.title: Investment integration review
screens.entry: Carta/Forecasting integration setup and update review
screens.controls: Entity/company matching, selection of incoming rounds, retention of existing events and source indicators.
screens.documented_behavior: Release documentation permits keeping forecasting events and selecting imported records. Fund-admin customers can source transactions from the schedule of investments, enriched by cap-table financing history.
screens.unverified: Exact permission roles, retry/conflict states and deep setup substeps; non-Carta support described as coming soon is not assumed live.

screens.title: Fund-actuals integration
screens.controls: Partner details, commitments, capital calls, distributions, fees and expenses imported from accounting.
screens.documented_behavior: This integration connects official fund actuals to modeling. It is separate from importing company cap-table rounds and from company KPI synchronization.
screens.unverified: Field-level overwrite precedence, posting-versus-cash conventions, lock periods and detailed sync status UI.

screens.title: Company-financials synchronization
screens.controls: Linked company financials and KPIs; downstream analytics.
screens.documented_behavior: For the documented joint-product integration, Data Collection/RFI is the source of truth and confirmed data synchronizes into forecasting. Do not confuse this with manual KPI request approval settings.
screens.unverified: Bidirectional edits, exact refresh delay and conflict behavior.

screens.title: SAFE/note conversion and ownership updates
screens.entry: Round security type → SAFE/Note; subsequent priced round
screens.controls: Investment amount, round size, cap; conversion simulation or post-conversion ownership/share inputs.
screens.documented_behavior: Ownership after conversion is supplied through an ownership update or priced-round share data. The guide recommends the cap-table calculator for competing instruments. A default value based on the latest cap can be overridden by a valuation event.
screens.unverified: Full calculator layout, conversion engine and uncapped-instrument treatment beyond the documented modeling workarounds.

screens.title: Investment liquidation preferences
screens.controls: Preference amount, participation/cap settings and surrounding preference stack; import from another case.
screens.documented_behavior: An active indicator appears on the exit event. This affects an investment exit, not the GP/LP fund waterfall.
screens.unverified: The guide has an inconsistent senior/junior label-description pairing. Verify actual stack ordering before implementing calculations.

screens.title: Fund-of-funds investment
screens.entry: Investments → Fund Investments → Add a Portfolio Fund
screens.controls: Existing modeled portfolio fund, investment amount, Construction/Current source forecast and Save.
screens.documented_behavior: Parent and child are separately modeled funds. The child’s calls/LP distributions become the parent’s investment cash flows. Same currency is required; nested FoF is documented as unsupported.
screens.unverified: Current entitlement and exact aggregation display. Documented start/end-date assumptions should be separately fixture-tested.

screens.title: Visual-accounting home and entity graph
screens.controls: Investment search, entity selection, connected fund/LP/GP records and workflow-focused views.
screens.documented_behavior: The tour positions investments left and funds centrally, with connected ownership interests. Selecting an entity reveals related economics; valuation/capital activity can be followed through the structure.
screens.unverified: Full current layout, zoom/selection mechanics, node types and navigation permissions. Written spatial descriptions are not screenshot verification.

screens.title: Deal CRM records, relationships and pipeline
screens.entry: Deal CRM; email ingestion or company record
screens.controls: Spreadsheet-style records, Interactions, People, pipeline stages, assigned coverage, advisers and AI research/query surfaces.
screens.documented_behavior: The email agent extracts incoming deal context. Interaction feeds combine team emails, meetings and notes under firm access rules. Configurable enrichment and document-based briefs are described.
screens.unverified: Do not infer Kanban dragging, perfect AI extraction, automatic deduplication or deal-to-investment conversion.

screens.title: LP CRM record and fundraising workspace
screens.controls: Relationship feed, commitments/performance, official communications, documents with engagement data, fundraising stages and closing initiation.
screens.documented_behavior: Fund admin supplies the economic record; IR works through the CRM. Subscription documents can be sent singly or in bulk, with closing status tracked.
screens.unverified: Exact stage configuration, automated transitions, pipeline layout and write access to economic fields.

screens.title: Closing command center and subscription review
screens.controls: Investor progress, questionnaire, tax uploads, subscription package, countersign and optional first capital call.
screens.documented_behavior: Documented progression is Invited → In progress → Signed → Countersigned. Existing LP data can prefill forms. Managers review the completed package before countersigning.
screens.unverified: Signer authority, rejected/reopened states, legal-document generation rules and premium conditional logic.

screens.title: Capital-call creation and notices
screens.controls: Call type, amount, participants/parameters, health checks, per-LP amounts, wire confirmation and notice preview.
screens.documented_behavior: The general tour describes sending a call and creating a journal dated to its due date. An older PE tour describes GL reflection after funding; keep recognition and payment events separate until resolved.
screens.unverified: Exact LPA checks, approvals, cancellation/reissue rules, late payments and accounting timing discrepancy.

screens.title: LP-facing portal and GP disclosure controls
screens.entry: LP consolidated holdings → entity; GP investor policies
screens.controls: SOI/performance, notices, documents, capital accounts, transaction ledger and wire details, subject to policy.
screens.documented_behavior: A login can expose the LP’s commitments across GPs. GPs control tab visibility and financial disclosure by LP, including date cutoffs; newly closed LPs inherit the selected policy.
screens.unverified: All tab labels and layouts, role combinations, export permissions and cross-GP identity handling.

screens.title: Fund Tax workspace
screens.controls: Missing-data tasks, LP contact requests, return review, K-1 delivery, representative access and e-filing.
screens.documented_behavior: The tour includes AI preparation followed by a licensed CPA’s finalization, then client review/signing and filing status. Estimates and final tax documents are separate outputs.
screens.unverified: All exact status names, reject/amend flows, jurisdiction variants and approval permissions. Never treat the demo as a real filing service.

screens.title: Data Collection configuration, submission and validation
screens.entry: Collection dashboard → company or request setup
screens.controls: Reporting period/currency, financials/KPIs/custom questions, contacts, cadence, reminders and upload links.
screens.documented_behavior: Uploaded financials undergo extraction and checks. Clicking an aggregate can trace contributing line items; confirmed values are saved with an audit trail into company financials/KPIs and downstream data tools.
screens.unverified: Extraction confidence rules, conflict resolution, attachment limits and handling of failed/late submissions.

screens.title: Portfolio valuation workbench and posting
screens.controls: As-of cap table, financial import, comparables, method weights, allocation analysis, report export and posting confirmation.
screens.documented_behavior: Methods include backsolve, post-money, public comparables, M&A and DCF. Results can be allocated through a capital structure. An explicit confirmation precedes posting into the investment schedule/ledger and related NAV updates.
screens.unverified: Exact method formulas, solver/discount settings, approvals and one garbled technical term in the transcript. Draft analysis is not posting.

screens.title: Multi-entity waterfall analysis
screens.controls: Pan/zoom structure; exit value/date; Run; own-fund versus deal-level results; stakeholder filters; expandable paths; Breakpoints matrix.
screens.documented_behavior: Proceeds, MOIC and IRR can be examined by stakeholder and distribution tier. A changed exit value requires running the analysis again.
screens.unverified: All tier-editing controls, solver behavior, legal restrictions and save/export states. This does not initiate payments.

screens.title: GP carry and vesting
screens.entry: Linked fund and GP entity; GP LLC interests
screens.controls: Carry-unit issuance, vesting schedules and member economics.
screens.documented_behavior: The tour links booked fund gains through the configured waterfall to vested member carry. Carry accrual or a valuation gain is not itself evidence that cash was paid.
screens.unverified: Forfeiture, termination, transfers, clawback, rounding and every date convention.

screens.title: Distribution authorization and payment tracking
screens.controls: Recipient authorization, bank-detail exceptions, consolidated transfer approval and investor-level tracking.
screens.documented_behavior: The documented flow includes Carta operations and an external bank approval. Individual net payments use confirmed LP instructions; missing details are flagged. Payment IDs and notifications support tracking.
screens.unverified: Precise payment-status vocabulary, reversal/error behavior and real integration permissions. A recreation must clearly simulate any disconnected payment action.

screens.title: Management-company accounting
screens.entry: ManCo expense, balance and reporting views
screens.controls: Expense allocations, intercompany balances, bulk settlement, subaccounts, reporting tags and journal drill-down.
screens.documented_behavior: Allocated spend generates intercompany accounting. The tour also describes budgeting/scenario work in Claude for Excel; that is an external integration, not proof of an identical native Carta budget editor.
screens.unverified: Every approval state, allocation rule and settlement screen.

screens.title: Ramp expense integration
screens.entry: Linked Ramp spend → Carta general ledger
screens.controls: Category/account mappings, expense splits, reporting tags and attached evidence.
screens.documented_behavior: Cards, bills and reimbursements can flow into accounting. Multi-entity splits create intercompany entries; invoices/receipts accompany the records.
screens.unverified: Exact setup UI, sync exceptions, permissions and transaction-conflict resolution. Do not replace actual Ramp screens with an invented native workflow.

screens.title: Auditor workspace
screens.controls: Audit-area categories, supporting documents, grouped downloads and confirmation requests.
screens.documented_behavior: Accounting, investment and tax evidence is assembled from connected records; the tour includes direct audit confirmations to portfolio companies and monitoring for missing documents.
screens.unverified: Auditor-specific permission granularity and all document-refresh/error states.

screens.title: KYC and ongoing diligence
screens.entry: KYC dashboard → investor → request or result
screens.controls: Verification status, secure document requests, watch-list results, review flags/history and CDD report.
screens.documented_behavior: The tour describes identity and screening workflows with compliance review. A flag requires investigation; it is not an automatic conclusion about the investor.
screens.unverified: Risk scoring, screening vendors, disposition rules, escalation and jurisdictional policy. A prototype must not claim actual verification.

screens.title: Data Explorer and warehouse-backed analysis
screens.entry: Curated collections → dashboard/table or new query
screens.controls: Entity filters, starting table, filters/aggregation, chart type, saved/shared queries and AI query assistance.
screens.documented_behavior: The tour connects accounting/ownership data to analytical views. Developer documentation identifies periodic refreshes, so a data-warehouse dashboard must not imply every record is instantaneously current.
screens.unverified: Exact present-day product naming, SQL/semantic-layer rules, entitlements and permissions on sharing.

screens.title: SPV formation and ongoing administration
screens.controls: Formation/legal/banking steps, investor subscriptions, capital activity, reporting and tax-service coordination.
screens.documented_behavior: Formation involves real services and legal entities. The subsequent SPV uses administrative workflows such as closings and the LP portal; this is not the forecasting model’s no-construction switch.
screens.unverified: Full formation wizard, legal templates, region-specific sequence, service pricing and activation states.

screens.title: Allocator-facing LP Portfolio Analytics
screens.controls: Document intake, extraction/validation, traceable data and portfolio dashboards.
screens.documented_behavior: This serves an allocator evaluating alternative assets across managers: concentration, allocation-policy deviation and cohort comparisons. It is distinct from an individual GP’s LP Portal or fundraising CRM.
screens.unverified: Detailed screens, intake queues, remediation dialogs, metric look-through logic and portfolio-aggregation rules.

screens.title: Loan Operations and borrower/co-lender access
screens.entry: Loan setup, reconciliation, covenant and reporting workspaces
screens.controls: Loan terms/draws, rates/PIK, repayments, invoices, payment reconciliation, covenant documents and reports.
screens.documented_behavior: Loan activity connects to accounting. Borrowers/co-lenders have separate document/data access. The product supports standalone use, but connected functionality depends on setup.
screens.unverified: Actual wizard/screens, interest/day-count calculations, amendments, allocation rules and full role matrix.

workflows.title: Create and construct a fund
workflows.contract: Persist economic configuration and present computed output; do not invent unobserved template defaults.

workflows.title: Maintain a portfolio investment
workflows.sequence: FF12 → FF14 → FF16 → FF15 → save investment → FF12/FF10
workflows.contract: Nested event editing must affect the correct case and only persist through the documented parent save.

workflows.title: Compare a fund scenario
workflows.sequence: FF17 → edit assumptions → recalculate → compare → save scenario
workflows.contract: Scenario changes remain distinguishable from base records and official accounting; applying-to-base remains unverified.

workflows.title: Review a historical period
workflows.sequence: FF12 → FF18 → chosen month → reset to today
workflows.contract: Historical analysis changes the displayed time context, not the underlying stored history.

workflows.title: Collect company KPIs
workflows.sequence: FF19 → FF20 → recipient submission → review or configured auto-approval
workflows.contract: Accepted values and pending submissions are separate states.

workflows.title: Progress an LP to a closed commitment
workflows.sequence: ERP03 → ERP04 → countersign → optional capital call → ERP06
workflows.contract: Carry investor context into administrative records while respecting disclosure policy.

workflows.title: Issue a capital call
workflows.sequence: ERP05 → configure → checks → amounts/wires → preview → submit → track funding
workflows.contract: Notice issuance, due-date recognition and cash receipt require distinct events; exact Carta journal timing is unresolved across sources.

workflows.title: Collect data and post a valuation
workflows.sequence: ERP08 → validate/save → ERP09 draft valuation → review allocation → confirm posting
workflows.contract: Only the explicit accounting action should affect booked investment values.

workflows.title: Model exit proceeds
workflows.sequence: ERP10 → exit value/date → run → stakeholders/breakpoints → rerun
workflows.contract: This is analytical modeling, not ERP12 payment authorization.

workflows.title: Execute a simulated distribution workflow
workflows.sequence: ERP12 → recipients → banking exceptions → external approval → status tracking
workflows.contract: In a disconnected recreation, outputs must remain clearly labeled simulation.

workflows.title: Complete tax workflow
workflows.sequence: ERP07 → missing-data collection → preparation/review → client signoff → delivery/filing status
workflows.contract: Preserve the professional review and external filing boundary rather than fabricating a valid filing.

workflows.title: Aggregate modeled funds
workflows.sequence: FF26 for an analytical group; FF33 for ownership in a portfolio fund
workflows.contract: These are different operations: a view is not an investment, and the latter carries cash flows.

conceptual_data_model.description: Firm owns scoped entities; grants limit user and module access.
A company can have financing history; a fund investment has its own owned position and dated events.
conceptual_data_model.evidence: I — relationships grounded in documents, not private schema

conceptual_data_model.description: Construction assumptions are versionable model inputs, separate from real transactions.
Case holds an investment’s alternative path; scenario changes selected assumptions across a fund.

conceptual_data_model.object: Investor / commitment / closing package / disclosure policy
conceptual_data_model.description: One investor may hold interests in several funds and see a policy-filtered subset of records.

conceptual_data_model.object: Capital activity / investor allocation / journal entry
conceptual_data_model.description: Carta’s public warehouse update documents fund-level activity, LP-level breakdowns and accounting links.
conceptual_data_model.evidence: D — public analytical data relationships, not transactional database schema

conceptual_data_model.object: Metric definition / period value / submission / source
conceptual_data_model.description: Keep pending submissions separate from accepted values and their provenance.
conceptual_data_model.evidence: I — proposed design of documented workflow

conceptual_data_model.object: Valuation draft / posted valuation / accounting effect
conceptual_data_model.description: Separate an analysis artifact from the accounting transaction it may produce.
conceptual_data_model.evidence: I — proposed design grounded in explicit posting step

conceptual_data_model.description: Store simulated payment progress independently from forecasted distributions.

conceptual_data_model.object: Document / access grant / extraction / review record
conceptual_data_model.description: Associate evidence with records; do not assume every document is visible to every user.
Analytical results should disclose source freshness and avoid masquerading as current transactional state.
conceptual_data_model.evidence: I — application recommendation; cadence itself is documented

acceptance_contracts.title: Stage-probability guard
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Enter graduation 60% and exit 50% at one stage.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Reject the invalid combination; do not create a negative failure probability.

acceptance_contracts.title: Terminal stage
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Enter a nonzero graduation probability in the last stage.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Require a terminal stage with no further graduation.

acceptance_contracts.title: Residual failure
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Use graduation 60%, exit 15%.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Computed failure is 25%, before any display rounding.

acceptance_contracts.title: Construction versus actuals
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Add an actual investment to a fund that already has a construction plan.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Current Forecast reflects actual deployment; Construction Forecast remains an inception model.

acceptance_contracts.title: Actual cash-flow override
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Override one monthly expense in the actuals editor.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Actual reporting changes; the override alone does not replan projected investment count.

acceptance_contracts.title: Nested save
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Edit a round, close its editor, then save the investment.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Verify the saved parent contains the edited event after reload. Behavior before parent save must be captured, not guessed.

acceptance_contracts.title: Scenario isolation
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Change exit assumptions inside a named scenario.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Base accounting must not change; recalculate and save actions have distinct, inspectable outcomes.
acceptance_contracts.basis: D for scenario actions; I for implementation isolation contract

acceptance_contracts.title: Historical mode
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Choose a historical month, then select Reset to today.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Metrics use each selected time context; historical records are not overwritten.

acceptance_contracts.title: Pending KPI submission
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Submit a new KPI while automatic approval is off.
acceptance_contracts.expected: A pending review is distinct from the accepted metric; accept and reject produce different stored states.

acceptance_contracts.title: KPI auto-approval branch
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Enable Auto-Approve and submit a valid update.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Follow the auto-approval branch rather than force a manual-review-only workflow.

acceptance_contracts.title: Scoped published reader
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Open an LP-specific published dashboard.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Reader is non-editable and cannot access other LP returns through exports or direct data requests.
acceptance_contracts.basis: D disclosure; I server-side enforcement requirement

acceptance_contracts.title: LP portal cutoff
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Set one LP to a historical disclosure cutoff.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Portal data respects both entity/tab visibility and the financial date policy.

acceptance_contracts.title: Valuation draft versus posting
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Change a draft valuation and compare booked balances, then post it.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Only the documented posting step triggers booked valuation effects.

acceptance_contracts.title: External payment boundary
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Create a distribution with missing recipient bank details.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Show the missing-information branch; never report a real transfer in a disconnected environment.

acceptance_contracts.title: Warehouse freshness
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Display a warehouse-derived value whose snapshot timestamp is older than the current record.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Expose the snapshot timestamp; do not label the figure as instant live accounting.

acceptance_contracts.title: Matched-basis performance multiples
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Synthetic LP fixture: paid in 10, distributions 3, residual value 12; all on the same basis.
acceptance_contracts.expected: DPI 0.3x; RVPI 1.2x; TVPI 1.5x. These are not observed Carta demo outputs.

acceptance_contracts.title: Undefined ratios
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Set paid-in capital to zero.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Show an explicitly unavailable result rather than Infinity or an invented zero.
acceptance_contracts.basis: I — recommended numeric safeguard; Carta presentation not verified

acceptance_contracts.title: IRR input quality
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Use only negative cash flows or an ambiguous sequence with multiple sign changes.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Surface invalid/ambiguous calculation status rather than fabricate a return. Solver conventions must be specified separately.

acceptance_contracts.title: Currency eligibility
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Create a multi-fund view from vehicles with different fund currencies.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Do not silently pool the values; the documented feature requires a common currency.

acceptance_contracts.title: FoF versus grouped view
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Compare adding a portfolio-fund investment to adding a fund to a grouped analytical view.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Only the investment creates linked investment cash flows.

acceptance_contracts.title: SAFE conversion
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Model an unconverted instrument, then provide a priced-round conversion outcome.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Apply the modeled/supplied ownership update; do not treat cap value as fully verified ownership.

acceptance_contracts.title: Relative formula period
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Rerun a saved formula using a relative prior-year KPI period at a later date.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Resolve the new relative date instead of freezing the original period.

acceptance_contracts.title: Import provenance
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Retain one local forecast event while accepting a selected imported event.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Both selected outcomes remain traceable; do not blindly replace all local history.

acceptance_contracts.title: Concurrent writes
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Have two authorized editors change the same saved model.
acceptance_contracts.expected: The guide describes last-save-wins. A safer prototype lock/conflict warning is a deliberate deviation, not claimed parity.
acceptance_contracts.basis: D documented limitation; I safer alternative

acceptance_contracts.title: Connected-record integrity
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Rename an investor or company in a synthetic connected record.
acceptance_contracts.expected: Relevant views use stable IDs, not copied names as identity keys.

acceptance_contracts.title: Functional controls
acceptance_contracts.fixture: Exercise each visible primary action in the recreation.
acceptance_contracts.expected: It changes state, opens a real destination, produces an output, or clearly explains an unavailable dependency; no decorative dead buttons.

gaps.known_limit: No complete current authenticated route/screen capture was achieved.
gaps.evidence_needed: Capture each target route at fixed desktop dimensions, with current role/entitlement and an as-of date. Do not invent exact menu order.

gaps.known_limit: Most embedded images/video players failed in available tools; a title card or thumbnail is not a verified screen.
gaps.evidence_needed: Obtain official downloadable frames or a working authorized browser session. Record viewport, state and source per frame.

gaps.known_limit: The guides identify analytics, but not complete tooltip/legend/drilldown behavior or outputs for a common fixture.
gaps.evidence_needed: Run one synthetic dataset through the actual product; capture chart states and underlying output tables.

gaps.known_limit: The retrieved Forecasting metrics article contains suspect minus operators; Carta’s educational definitions imply addition for TVPI.
gaps.evidence_needed: Use consistent-basis formulas as cross-checks, but verify product-specific fees, debt, cash, timing and gross/net conventions before claiming exact parity.

gaps.known_limit: General and PE-specific tours describe different GL timing.
gaps.evidence_needed: Confirm notice/receivable recognition and funded-cash entries separately. Do not silently choose a transcript.

gaps.known_limit: Clawback wording and one investment preference label-description pairing are ambiguous.
gaps.evidence_needed: Verify original UI and documented legal/economic ordering; test capped/participating and catch-up cases independently.

gaps.known_limit: Overview pages expose branch labels without all detailed substeps.
gaps.evidence_needed: Inspect source/target roles, selected imports, overwrites, retry failures, revocation and re-sync behavior.

gaps.known_limit: Not every module documents drafts, undo, deletes, validation messages, duplicate prevention or import templates.
gaps.evidence_needed: Capture empty, dirty, invalid, saving, success, failure and permission-denied states for each implemented flow.

gaps.known_limit: US/regional pages and older support plans differ. Some announced capabilities are explicitly future-looking.
gaps.evidence_needed: Pin an actual target account/package/version. Do not merge all public features into a purported universal Carta menu.

gaps.known_limit: Read/write controls, LP disclosure and external-user roles are documented, but not a complete cross-product matrix.
gaps.evidence_needed: Verify each persona against each entity/action/export/API path.

gaps.known_limit: Read-only publishing is documented; exact freshness, revoke/expire behavior is not.
gaps.evidence_needed: Compare a published link before/after edits and after access changes.

gaps.known_limit: FoF/SAFE/preferences are documented; cap-table calculator internals, backsolve, secondary optimization, credit-line edge cases and every API are not exhaustively specified here.
gaps.evidence_needed: Expand those individual features only when they enter the intended build scope; do not label index-only features implemented.

gaps.topic: LP Portfolio Analytics and Loan Operations screens
gaps.known_limit: Public feature behavior is clearer than complete screen sequence or calculation detail.
gaps.evidence_needed: Obtain module-specific tours/captures, not screenshots borrowed from Forecasting or fund admin.

gaps.known_limit: Domain/table index is visible, but the full column dictionary fetch timed out.
gaps.evidence_needed: Treat the proposed application model as inferred; do not claim actual transactional database compatibility.

gaps.known_limit: Tax filing, compliance checks, entity formation, Ramp and banking involve systems outside a local app.
gaps.evidence_needed: Use clearly labeled simulations unless authorized production integrations and professional service processes are actually provided.

gaps.known_limit: Legacy limits and last-save-wins behavior are documented but not reconfirmed for the intended current account.
gaps.evidence_needed: Keep limits configurable and mark any intentionally improved collaboration behavior as a deviation.
